verdict.rationale: Fireflies can be driven headlessly through its GraphQL API. Scripts authenticate with a static bearer API key, upload audio via the uploadAudio mutation with a completion webhook, and pull results through the transcripts and transcript queries. Zapier webhooks also support unattended pipelines. There is no first-party CLI, SDK, or CI-specific tooling, so users must write their own GraphQL client code. missing for 10: official CLI or SDK for headless use, documented CI/CD integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or a non-interactive runner), published OpenAPI or machine-readable schema endpoint beyond introspection, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
